providers.name: SiliconFlow 硅基流动
providers.notes_zh: 注册即送额度；DeepSeek / Qwen 等多款小模型永久免费（免费 SKU 列表高频轮换，以价格页为准）
providers.notes_en: Free credits on signup; several small models (DeepSeek/Qwen) free forever (the free-SKU list rotates often — confirm on the pricing page)

providers.name: Z.AI (智谱 GLM)
providers.notes_zh: GLM-4.5-Flash / GLM-4.7-Flash 免费；新用户赠翻译/体验额度（旗舰 GLM-5.3-Flash 为付费）
providers.notes_en: GLM-4.5-Flash and GLM-4.7-Flash are free; new users get trial credits (flagship GLM-5.3-Flash is paid)

providers.name: OpenRouter :free
providers.notes_zh: 带 :free 后缀的模型免费（有每日请求数限制，且列表高频轮换）；充 $10 可提升限额。建议添加后从上游 /v1/models 重新拉取当前 :free 列表
providers.notes_en: Models with a :free suffix are free (daily request caps; the list rotates fast); $10 top-up raises limits. Re-import the current :free list from upstream /v1/models after adding

providers.name: Pollinations
providers.notes_zh: 无需 Key 即可用（匿名有频率限制）；注册 token 可提升限额
providers.notes_en: Works without a key (anonymous rate limits); a free token raises the caps

providers.name: NVIDIA NIM
providers.notes_zh: 注册送 1000 credits（1 credit=1 请求），几十款模型随便试
providers.notes_en: 1000 free credits on signup (1 credit = 1 request) across dozens of models

providers.name: Groq
providers.notes_zh: 免费层（无需绑卡）有每日/每分钟限额，区别于付费 Developer 档；gpt-oss 系列为当前免费主力（preview 模型可能随时下线）
providers.notes_en: Free tier (no card) with daily/per-minute caps, distinct from the paid Developer tier; gpt-oss models are the current free mainstay (preview models may be discontinued at short notice)

providers.name: Mistral La Plateforme
providers.notes_zh: 免费实验层（需在后台开启 Experiment plan），含 Codestral 代码模型
providers.notes_en: Free 'Experiment' tier (opt-in in console), includes Codestral coding model

providers.name: Cloudflare Workers AI
providers.notes_zh: 每天 10000 neurons 免费额度；base_url 里的 {account_id} 要替换成你自己的
providers.notes_en: 10,000 free neurons/day; replace {account_id} in the base_url with your own

providers.name: Google AI Studio (Gemini)
providers.notes_zh: 免费层无需绑卡；gemini-3.x-flash 系列为 $0，按 RPM/RPD 限额每日重置（需在 AI Studio 申请 API key）
providers.notes_en: Free tier needs no card; gemini-3.x-flash models are $0, RPM/RPD quotas reset daily (get an API key in AI Studio)

providers.name: SambaNova (SambaCloud)
providers.notes_zh: 免费层无需绑卡：每模型 20 RPM / 20 RPD / 20 万 TPD，每日重置；专用推理芯片，速度极快
providers.notes_en: Free tier needs no card: 20 RPM / 20 RPD / 200K TPD per model, resets daily; dedicated inference silicon, very fast

providers.name: Hugging Face Router
providers.notes_zh: 每月循环免费额度（无需支付方式），可用于所有 Inference Providers 聊天模型；额度较小，适合试用
providers.notes_en: Recurring monthly free credit (no card) usable on all Inference Providers chat models; small quota, good for trying

providers.name: Fireworks AI
providers.notes_zh: 新账户注册即获一次性 $1 免费额度（邮箱/社交自助注册、无需绑卡即可开始）；用尽后需付费购买更多额度
providers.notes_en: New accounts get a one-time $1 free credit via self-serve signup (no card to start); buy more credits once it runs out

providers.name: Novita AI
providers.notes_zh: 注册即赠 $1 信用额度且无需绑卡；另有 $0 限时免费模型（ling-3.0-flash-fin 等），限时促销可能随时结束
providers.notes_en: $1 signup credit (no card); plus $0 time-limited free models (ling-3.0-flash-fin etc.) — promos may end anytime

providers.name: Requesty (LLM Router)
providers.notes_zh: 免费层每日 200 次请求、无需信用卡、无试用到期；仅限免费模型（目录会变动，以 requesty.ai/models/free 为准）
providers.notes_en: Free tier: 200 requests/day, no card, no trial expiry; free models only (catalog changes — see requesty.ai/models/free)

providers.name: Cohere
providers.notes_zh: 免费试用 API key（无需信用卡），每月 1,000 次调用、每模型 20 req/min；通过 OpenAI 兼容端点使用
providers.notes_en: Free trial API key (no card), 1,000 calls/month + 20 req/min per model; via the OpenAI-compatible endpoint

providers.name: Alibaba Cloud Bailian (DashScope)
providers.notes_zh: 首次开通百炼即发 90 天新人免费额度（如 qwen-plus/qwen-max，约 100 万 token/模型），无需绑卡；仅北京区域
providers.notes_en: Free quota auto-granted on Model Studio activation (~1M tokens/model, 90 days, e.g. qwen-plus/qwen-max), no card; Beijing region only

providers.name: Volcengine Ark (Doubao)
providers.notes_zh: 新用户实名认证后享安心体验模式免费额度（每模型约 50 万 token，无需绑卡）；doubao-seed 模型 id 带日期后缀且频繁轮换，请在控制台模型列表确认当前可用 id
providers.notes_en: New users get ~500K-token free quota per model via safe-experience mode after real-name auth (no card); doubao-seed model IDs are date-suffixed and rotate — confirm current IDs in the console model list

providers.name: Moonshot Kimi (Kimi API 开放平台)
providers.notes_zh: 注册并完成实名认证后赠 15 元代金券（无需支付方式），可用于 kimi-k2.6 / kimi-k2.7-code（旗舰 kimi-k3 不支持）；用尽后按量付费
providers.notes_en: 15 CNY free voucher on signup after real-name auth (no payment method); usable on kimi-k2.6 / kimi-k2.7-code (flagship kimi-k3 not supported); pay-as-you-go after

providers.name: AI21
providers.notes_zh: 新账号赠 $10 免费额度（3 个月有效，无需绑卡即可开始），可用于 Jamba Large/Mini（Mamba-Transformer 混合架构，256K 上下文）；到期或用尽后才需绑定支付方式
providers.notes_en: New accounts get a $10 free credit valid 3 months (no card to start), usable on Jamba Large/Mini (Mamba-Transformer hybrid, 256K context); billing info required only after the trial expires/exceeds

providers.name: Baidu ERNIE / Qianfan (百度千帆)
providers.notes_zh: 百度千帆 ModelBuilder，OpenAI 兼容；新用户实名认证后赠 20 元代金券（全平台无门槛、1 个月有效、无需绑卡），可免费调用 ernie-4.5/ernie-5.0/deepseek-v4.1-flash 等；代金券到期按量付费
providers.notes_en: Baidu Qianfan ModelBuilder, OpenAI-compatible; new users get a ¥20 voucher after real-name auth (platform-wide, 1 month, no card) usable on ernie-4.5/ernie-5.0/deepseek-v4.1-flash; pay-as-you-go after the voucher expires

providers.name: Stepfun (阶跃星辰)
providers.notes_zh: 阶跃星辰开放平台，OpenAI 兼容；新用户赠送额度（实名认证无需绑卡，有有效期），可用 step-5-preview / step-3.7-flash / step-3.5-flash；仅赠送额度时为 V0 速率档（5 并发 / 100 RPM / 500K TPM）
providers.notes_en: Stepfun open platform, OpenAI-compatible; new users get gifted credits (real-name auth, no card, expires) usable on step-5-preview / step-3.7-flash / step-3.5-flash; free-only users sit at rate tier V0 (5 concurrency / 100 RPM / 500K TPM)

providers.name: iFlyTek Spark (讯飞星火)
providers.notes_zh: 科大讯飞星火，OpenAI 兼容（用控制台 APIPassword 作 Bearer token）；lite 版永久免费，另可在产品页领取免费额度（实名认证无需绑卡）；模型 id 含 lite / generalv3 / generalv3.5 / 4.0Ultra
providers.notes_en: iFlyTek Spark, OpenAI-compatible (uses the console APIPassword as a Bearer token); the lite model is perpetually free, plus a claimable free quota on the product page (real-name auth, no card); model IDs include lite / generalv3 / generalv3.5 / 4.0Ultra

providers.name: Tencent Hunyuan (腾讯混元)
providers.notes_zh: 腾讯混元，OpenAI 兼容；首次开通（腾讯云实名认证，无需绑卡）即赠免费资源包：生文模型共享 100 万 tokens（1 年有效）；模型含 hunyuan-a13b / hunyuan-role-latest / hunyuan-translation 等。注意官方公告功能正逐步迁移至 TokenHub，免费额度以首次开通为准
providers.notes_en: Tencent Hunyuan, OpenAI-compatible; first activation (Tencent Cloud real-name auth, no card) grants a free resource package: 1M shared tokens for text models (valid 1 year); models include hunyuan-a13b / hunyuan-role-latest / hunyuan-translation. Note: an official notice says features are migrating to TokenHub; the free quota is granted on first activation

providers.name: ModelScope (魔搭社区)
providers.notes_zh: 阿里达摩院开源 MaaS 平台，API-Inference 免费提供 1000+ 开源模型推理（注册送 200 Magicubes，每日续赠，无需绑卡）；与已收录的 DashScope/Bailian 是不同服务（免费开源模型 vs 官方付费 API）。模型 id 为 org/model 格式，建议运行时拉取 /v1/models
providers.notes_en: Alibaba DAMO open-source MaaS hub; API-Inference serves 1000+ open-source models free (200 Magicubes on signup + daily top-up, no card); distinct from the cataloged DashScope/Bailian (free open-source inference vs official paid API). Model IDs use org/model form; enumerate via /v1/models at runtime

providers.name: Infermatic
providers.notes_zh: Infermatic（域名 infermatic.ai，API 域名 api.totalgpt.ai），OpenAI 兼容（vLLM 后端）；有免费计划及专属 Free 模型档，另有 $9/$20 付费档；鉴权 Bearer API Key
providers.notes_en: Infermatic (domain infermatic.ai; API host api.totalgpt.ai), OpenAI-compatible (vLLM backend); has a free plan with a dedicated Free-models tier plus paid $9/$20 tiers; Bearer API key auth
